audit.whatIsWrong: Sides for Levels 1-3 contradicted the prose and the packet chart: win[]/phases[].side read Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank while whys[1] and spikes[0] call Level 2-3 'your one real attacking window' and whys[2] calls Level 3 a read. Packet levelChart is Graves, Graves, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank.
audit.why: The page tells you to force the 2-3 all-in and then shows Gangplank owning those levels.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group to Graves, Graves, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, matching packet and the existing whys. Late-game rows (Gangplank) untouched — the mirror left its chart as-is there.

audit.why: spikes[] already track the real spikes: Lvl 2-3 window, Level 6 Collateral Damage on a baited stack, Sheen/first item flipping to Gangplank, full build out-ranging you. Remove Scurvy's 22/20/18/16/14s cooldown added to whys[1] to make the early window concrete.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy rank-1 cooldown (22s) stated in whys[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen was described as a BLIND in four places on this page (whys[1], early, wants.you[1], report[10]) plus the stale 'smoke-screen blinds' line in phases[6].why. Riot's text is a sight-range reduction plus impact magic damage and a brief slow — nothing stops Parrrley or his keg-detonation auto.
audit.why: Same hard error the mirror audit fixed on Gangplank's side. A player who thinks the cloud blinds will stand in it and eat the barrel chain.
audit.corrected: All five rewritten to sight-cut/nearsight plus slow. Kept the true interaction: the fog makes him misplace kegs, and Remove Scurvy cleanses the slow, so the slow is not what holds him.

audit.why: packet flagged 'His Remove Scurvy' in spikes[0] as a probable wrong ability name — false positive; Remove Scurvy is Gangplank's real W.

edits.before: With E and Smoke Screen online you dash into point-blank shell range, blind his detonation auto, and Q-cone him before barrels chain, while his Remove Scurvy heal is still on a long cooldown.
edits.after: With E and Smoke Screen online you dash into point-blank shell range, cut his sight so kegs land wrong, and Q-cone him before barrels chain, while Remove Scurvy is a 22s cooldown at rank 1.

edits.before: Drop Smoke Screen on him to blind his barrel-detonation auto and gut his vision so he misplaces the next keg
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen to wreck his keg placement — it cuts sight and slows, it never blinds his detonation auto

edits.before: Your whole shot at this lane is the level 2-3 window. You have one ability and short range at level 1, so eat the barrel poke, last-hit with the tip of your Q, and wait. The moment you have E and W, dash in for the point-blank 4-shell spread and Q-cone him before he can chain two barrels. That close his kegs are awkward to detonate, and his Remove Scurvy is still on a long early cooldown so he can't cleanse the commit. Drop Smoke Screen on him to blind his barrel-detonation auto and brick the chain. If he already has a barrel net laid down, do not walk into it. Back off and reset.
edits.after: Your whole shot at this lane is the level 2-3 window. You have one ability and short range at level 1, so eat the barrel poke, last-hit with the tip of your Q, and wait. The moment you have E and W, dash in for the point-blank 4-shell spread and Q-cone him before he can chain two barrels. That close his kegs are awkward to detonate, and Remove Scurvy is a 22s cooldown at rank 1, so he can't cleanse the commit. Smoke Screen cuts his sight and slows on impact — it never blinds the detonation auto, so use it to misplace his next keg, not to brick the chain. If a barrel net is already laid, do not walk in.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: His barrel crits and global R out-range you late — convert to picks with smoke-screen fog and R snipes.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows on impact — no blind. Drop it as the gank arrives and fight them blind-sided in the fog.

notes: Smoke Screen described as a blind in five places here — corrected to sight-cut plus slow, matching the mirror audit's fix on Gangplank's side. Level 1-3 sides contradicted the page's own 'your one real attacking window' prose and packet.levelChart; flipped as a group. Late-game rows left to Gangplank, agreeing with the mirror. packet defect at spikes[0] ('His Remove Scurvy') is a false positive.
